entities.summary: Semih Terzi was a general in the Turkish Army, who was shot at the headquarters of the Special Forces Command during the failed 2016 Turkish coup attempt of 15 July. He was taken to the Gülhane Military Medical Academy (GATA) at 06:01, four hours after he was shot and according to witness reports, he was able to sit and talk when he was first brought to the hospital; he was announced dead the next day.
